person.tagline_zh: 时间序列分析、时序多智能体、时序基础模型与人工智能辅助药物设计。
person.tagline_en: Time series analysis, time series multi-agent systems, foundation models, and AI-assisted drug discovery.
bio_zh: 我是余洋，安徽理工大学计算机科学与工程学院特聘副教授、硕士生导师，兼任杭州云象纪智能科技有限公司科技副总。我的研究围绕时间序列分析、时序多智能体与时序基础模型展开，希望让模型和智能体更好地利用数值观测、文本与图像信息，理解动态过程，并完成从数据分析到预测和决策支持的连续任务。我也开展人工智能辅助药物设计研究，探索预训练模型在生物序列分析和药物研发中的应用。
此前，我在南京航空航天大学获得软件工程博士学位，并在新加坡管理大学进行联合培养。已有研究涉及鲁棒长期预测、扩散式数据增强、外生变量建模和跨域迁移。目前重点推进时序基础模型适配、多模态时态对齐，以及能够协作调用工具、追踪信息来源的时序多智能体系统。我也参与大模型开源教程和人工智能实践教学，希望让研究方法更容易被复现和使用。
bio_en: I am Yang Yu, a Specially Appointed Associate Professor and master's supervisor at the School of Computer Science and Engineering, Anhui University of Science and Technology, and also serve as Deputy General Manager for Science and Technology at Hangzhou Yunxiangji Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. (杭州云象纪智能科技有限公司). My research focuses on time series analysis, time series multi-agent systems, and time series foundation models. I study how models and agents can use numerical observations, text, and images to understand temporal processes and support forecasting and decision-making. I also work on AI-assisted drug discovery, exploring pre-trained models for biological sequence analysis and drug development.

I received my Ph.D. in Software Engineering from Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics and undertook joint doctoral training at Singapore Management University. My work spans robust forecasting, diffusion-based data augmentation, exogenous information modeling, and cross-domain adaptation. I am currently exploring time series foundation models, multimodal temporal alignment, and time series multi-agent systems for end-to-end time series analysis. I also contribute to open-source learning resources and practical AI education.

person.recruitment_zh: 欢迎对前沿技术与科学研究感兴趣、愿意投入时间深入探索的本科生和硕士生联系交流。研究方向包括时间序列分析、时序多智能体、时序基础模型和人工智能辅助药物设计，也有无人车、无人机等相关应用项目可以参与。希望同学对前沿 AI 研究及工程实现感兴趣，愿意阅读论文，并动手实现前沿理论或技术。可结合研究进展与个人发展意愿，推荐至华东师范大学、东南大学、南京航空航天大学、河海大学等高校继续攻读博士学位，也可内推至业界前沿算法岗位实习，并提供后续招聘内推机会。
person.recruitment_en: I welcome undergraduate and master's students who are curious about emerging technologies and willing to invest time in research. Topics include time series analysis, time series multi-agent systems, foundation models, and AI-assisted drug discovery, with opportunities to participate in applied projects involving unmanned vehicles and aerial systems. I value an interest in frontier AI research and engineering implementation, along with a willingness to read papers and implement new theories and techniques hands-on. Depending on research progress and career goals, I can recommend students for doctoral study at East China Normal University, Southeast University, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, Hohai University, and other institutions. I can also provide referrals for cutting-edge industry algorithm internships and subsequent full-time recruiting opportunities.
person.collaboration_zh: 欢迎围绕时间序列分析、时序多智能体、时序基础模型与人工智能辅助药物设计开展联合研究。可共同研究多模态时序数据的补全、对齐与融合，全流程时序分析多智能体系统、工具调用与结果溯源，以及知识增强的生物序列分析；在药物设计方向，与华东师范大学生命科学学院阳怀宇课题组合作开展研究。依托已参与的国家重点研发计划、国家自然科学基金和横向技术开发项目，我也关注中小河流洪水防控与水资源管理、能源预测、工业设备故障知识图谱、复杂空管时空知识表征、低空监视无人机、反无人机系统、无人车上装设备、智能履带底盘及超轻型 eVTOL 等应用。合作形式包括联合申报课题、论文与算法研究、数据和评测基准建设、软件平台与原型系统开发、成果落地和实践教学资源共建。现挂职杭州云象纪智能科技有限公司科技副总，可协同推进科研方法与产业需求对接。
person.collaboration_en: I welcome joint research on time series analysis, time series multi-agent systems, time series foundation models, and AI-assisted drug discovery. Possible topics include multimodal temporal data completion, alignment and fusion; full-cycle multi-agent analysis systems with tool use and provenance tracking; and knowledge-enhanced biological sequence analysis. In drug discovery, I collaborate with Huaiyu Yang's research group at the School of Life Sciences, East China Normal University. Drawing on national R&D programs, NSFC projects, and industry-funded development projects, I also work on flood prevention and water resources management, energy forecasting, equipment-fault knowledge graphs, spatio-temporal knowledge representation for air traffic management, low-altitude surveillance drones, counter-UAS systems, unmanned ground vehicles, intelligent tracked chassis, and ultralight eVTOL platforms. Collaboration can include joint grant applications, publications and algorithm research, shared datasets and benchmarks, software platforms and prototypes, technology transfer, and open teaching resources. As Deputy General Manager for Science and Technology (concurrent appointment) at Hangzhou Yunxiangji Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. (杭州云象纪智能科技有限公司), I also help connect research methods with real industrial needs.

research.description_zh: 研究复杂动态过程的长期预测、概率预测、状态识别与跨场景泛化，关注非平稳变化、有限样本和外生因素对预测的影响。已有工作包括 Robformer、DiffAT、居民用电概率预测和 FPSO-Time；正在推进扩散式域适应及全流程时序分析研究。
research.description_en: Long-term and probabilistic forecasting, state identification, and cross-scenario generalization of complex dynamic processes, with attention to non-stationarity, limited samples, and exogenous factors. Work so far includes Robformer, DiffAT, probabilistic residential electricity forecasting, and FPSO-Time; current work advances diffusion-based domain adaptation and full-cycle time series analysis.

research.zh: 时序多智能体与协同分析
research.en: Multi-Agent Systems for Time Series Analysis
research.description_zh: 研究智能体在数据探索、状态识别、预测建模与决策支持中的协作方式，关注中间结果如何被后续环节使用，以及任务变化后如何调整分析过程。推进全流程分析系统、评测基准、通信机制和执行过程可追溯研究。
research.description_en: How agents collaborate in data exploration, state identification, forecasting modeling, and decision support: how intermediate results are used by later stages, and how the analysis process adapts when tasks change. We advance full-cycle analysis systems, evaluation benchmarks, communication mechanisms, and traceable execution.

research.zh: 时序基础模型与多模态学习
research.en: Time Series Foundation Models and Multimodal Learning
research.description_zh: 研究预训练模型对时序规律的表征与利用，关注模型适配、外生信息建模和跨任务泛化。结合数值序列、图像和文本之间的时间对应与语义关联，探索通过未来状态预测学习共同表示，为预测任务和智能体信息交换提供基础。当前工作包括外生变量适配、三模态时态对齐与潜表示预测。
research.description_en: How pre-trained models represent and exploit temporal regularity, with attention to model adaptation, exogenous information modeling, and cross-task generalization. By combining temporal correspondence and semantic association among numerical series, images, and text, we explore learning shared representations through future-state prediction, providing a basis for forecasting tasks and agent information exchange. Current work includes exogenous-variable adaptation, tri-modal temporal alignment, and latent representation prediction.

research.zh: 人工智能辅助药物设计
research.description_zh: 结合预训练模型、生物序列表示与领域知识，开展人工智能辅助药物设计研究。已有工作涉及蛋白质序列的离子通道识别，并推进知识增强与智能体方法在相关科研任务中的应用；目前与华东师范大学生命科学学院阳怀宇课题组合作开展相关研究，欢迎与药学、生物信息团队开展交叉合作。
research.description_en: AI-assisted drug discovery combining pre-trained models, biological sequence representations, and domain knowledge. Work includes ion channel identification from protein sequences and knowledge-enhanced, agent-based methods for related research tasks. Current research is conducted in collaboration with Huaiyu Yang's research group at the School of Life Sciences, East China Normal University; interdisciplinary collaboration with pharmacy and bioinformatics teams is welcome.
